data.name: Help_FAQ_ViewSchedule_Q
data.value: How do I view my schedule?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ViewSchedule_A
data.value: Go to Calendar from the sidebar menu. Use the "Just Mine" toggle to filter the view to only your assignments. You can switch between Week, Two Weeks, and Month views using the view selector.

data.name: Help_FAQ_CalendarViews_Q
data.value: What are the different calendar views?

data.name: Help_FAQ_CalendarViews_A
data.value: The calendar has separate views for Shifts (regular duty assignments), Chores (cleaning and maintenance tasks), and On-Call (duty rotation). Each view can be filtered by molecule, area, and time period. Use the navigation arrows or date picker to change the displayed period.

data.name: Help_FAQ_PrintSchedule_Q
data.value: How do I print the schedule?

data.name: Help_FAQ_PrintSchedule_A
data.value: Click the Print button in the calendar toolbar, or use the keyboard shortcut Ctrl+P. The calendar will display in a print-optimized format without the toolbar and navigation elements.

data.name: Help_FAQ_VacationRequest_A
data.value: Go to My Requests from the sidebar and click "New Request". Select "Vacation" as the type, choose your dates, and submit. Your request will be routed to the appropriate approvers based on your unit's approval chain. You can track the status in the Requests page.

data.name: Help_FAQ_SwapShift_Q
data.value: How do I swap a shift with someone?

data.name: Help_FAQ_SwapShift_A
data.value: Go to My Requests, click "New Request", and select "Swap". Choose the shift you want to swap and the person you want to swap with. Both parties and the relevant manager must approve the swap before it takes effect.

data.name: Help_FAQ_RequestStatus_Q
data.value: How do I check the status of my request?

data.name: Help_FAQ_RequestStatus_A
data.value: Go to My Requests from the sidebar. All your submitted requests are listed with their current status (Pending, Approved, Declined). You will also receive notifications when your request status changes.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ChangePassword_Q
data.value: How do I change my password?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ChangePassword_A
data.value: Go to My Profile from the sidebar. Scroll to the password section and enter your current password followed by your new password. Click Save to update.

data.name: Help_FAQ_Notifications_Q
data.value: How do I manage my notifications?

data.name: Help_FAQ_Notifications_A
data.value: Go to Settings from the sidebar. You can configure which notifications you receive and your preferred notification delivery method (in-app, email, or both).

data.name: Help_FAQ_CantLogin_Q
data.value: I can't log in. What should I do?

data.name: Help_FAQ_CantLogin_A
data.value: If your account is locked after too many failed attempts, wait a few minutes and try again. If you still cannot log in, contact your manager or system administrator to check your account status and reset your password if needed.

data.name: Help_FAQ_StaleData_Q
data.value: The calendar shows outdated information. What should I do?

data.name: Help_FAQ_StaleData_A
data.value: If you see a yellow or red banner at the top of the page indicating a connection issue, the real-time updates are interrupted. Try refreshing the page (F5). If the problem persists, check your network connection.

data.name: Help_FAQ_PageError_Q
data.value: I see an error message on the page. What should I do?

data.name: Help_FAQ_PageError_A
data.value: Try refreshing the page. If the error persists, note the error message and contact your system administrator. Include the page URL, what action you were performing, and the approximate time of the error.

data.name: Help_ContactSupport
data.value: Contact your manager or system administrator for additional assistance.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ViewChores_Q
data.value: How do I view my assigned chores?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ViewChores_A
data.value: Navigate to the Chores page from the main menu. You'll see a list of all chores assigned to you, organized by date. You can filter by status to see pending, completed, or all chores.

data.name: Help_FAQ_OnDuty_Q
data.value: How does the on-duty schedule work?

data.name: Help_FAQ_OnDuty_A
data.value: The on-duty schedule shows who is responsible for on-call duties for each day. Your manager assigns on-duty rotations. You can view the current and upcoming on-duty assignments from the On-Duty page.

data.name: Help_FAQ_CreateShift_Q
data.value: How do I create a new shift?

data.name: Help_FAQ_CreateShift_A
data.value: Go to the Calendar page and click on the date where you want to add a shift. Fill in the shift details including time, job type, and any notes. Click Save to create the shift.

data.name: Help_FAQ_AssignEmployee_Q
data.value: How do I assign an employee to a shift?

data.name: Help_FAQ_AssignEmployee_A
data.value: Open an existing shift from the calendar, then use the assignment panel to select an employee. You can also drag and drop employees from the roster dock directly onto shift slots.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ApproveRequests_Q
data.value: How do I approve or deny employee requests?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ApproveRequests_A
data.value: Go to the Requests page to see all pending requests. Review each request and click Approve or Deny. You can also add a note explaining your decision.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ManageUsers_Q
data.value: How do I manage users and roles?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ManageUsers_A
data.value: Navigate to Admin > Users to view all employees. From there you can add new users, edit existing users, change roles, and manage department assignments.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ExportSchedule_Q
data.value: How do I export the schedule?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ExportSchedule_A
data.value: Use the Export button on the Calendar or Schedule Table page. You can export to Excel format. Select the date range and departments you want to include in the export.

data.name: Help_FAQ_ScheduleTable_Q
data.value: What is the Schedule Table view?

data.name: Help_FAQ_ScheduleTable_A
data.value: The Schedule Table provides a grid view of all shifts organized by employee and date. It's useful for getting an overview of the entire team's schedule and identifying coverage gaps.

data.name: Help_FAQ_KeyboardShortcuts_A
data.value: Press Shift+? anywhere in the application to see a list of all available keyboard shortcuts. Common shortcuts include navigation between pages, quick actions, and calendar controls.

data.name: Help_FAQ_CommandPalette_A
data.value: The Command Palette (Ctrl+J) provides quick access to all pages and actions. Start typing to search for any page, feature, or action. Press Enter to navigate directly to the selected item.

data.name: Help_GettingStarted_Subtitle
data.value: Everything you need to know to get up and running with ShiftManager

data.name: Help_GS_WhatIs_A
data.value: ShiftManager is a shift scheduling and management system designed for organizations with multiple teams, roles, and shift types. It handles shift assignments, chore scheduling, on-call rotations, vacation requests, and more.

data.name: Help_GS_Signup_A
data.value: Click the "Join" button on the login page. Fill in your details, select your company and role, and submit the request. A manager will review and approve your request. Once approved, you can log in with your credentials.

data.name: Help_GS_FirstLogin_Q
data.value: What should I do after my first login?

data.name: Help_GS_FirstLogin_A
data.value: After logging in: 1) Check your profile and update your display name if needed. 2) Review your assigned role and company. 3) Navigate to the Calendar to see your shifts. 4) Set up notifications in your profile settings.

data.name: Help_GS_Navigation_Q
data.value: How do I navigate the system?

data.name: Help_GS_Navigation_A
data.value: Use the sidebar menu to access different sections: Calendar (Shifts, Chores, On-Call, Overview), My section (Profile, Requests, Help), and Admin section (if you have management permissions). You can collapse the sidebar for more screen space.

data.name: Help_GS_RequestAccess_Q
data.value: What if I need access to additional features?

data.name: Help_GS_RequestAccess_A
data.value: Contact your manager or system administrator. They can assign you additional roles or grants that unlock more features. You can see your current permissions in your profile page.

data.name: Help_Roles_Subtitle
data.value: Understanding roles, permissions, and what each role can do

data.name: Help_Roles_Overview_Q
data.value: What roles exist in the system?

data.name: Help_Roles_Overview_A
data.value: ShiftManager has the following roles: Employee (basic user), Manager (manages a company), Lead (team lead with extended permissions), BR Director (battalion-level commander), Molecule Admin (molecule-level director), Area Admin (area-level administrator), Assigner (shift assignment specialist), Trainee (supervised employee), and Owner (full system access).

data.name: Help_Roles_Employee_A
data.value: Employees can view their own shifts and schedules, submit vacation and swap requests, view chore assignments, update their profile, and see the team overview calendar.

data.name: Help_Roles_Manager_A
data.value: Managers can do everything an Employee can, plus: assign and unassign shifts, approve or reject vacation and swap requests, manage users in their company, view audit logs, and configure shift types and chore types.

data.name: Help_Roles_Lead_A
data.value: Leads have similar permissions to Managers but are specifically designated as team leaders. They can manage shifts, approve requests, and handle chore assignments for their team.

data.name: Help_Roles_Director_Q
data.value: What can a BR Director do?

data.name: Help_Roles_Director_A
data.value: BR Directors operate at the battalion level with extended management permissions over their company. They can assign shifts, manage users, and approve requests at the company level.

data.name: Help_Roles_MoleculeAdmin_Q
data.value: What can a Molecule Admin do?

data.name: Help_Roles_MoleculeAdmin_A
data.value: Molecule Admins have oversight over an entire molecule (group of companies). They can view and manage operations across all companies in their molecule, access cross-company analytics, and approve requests at a higher level.

data.name: Help_Roles_AreaAdmin_Q
data.value: What can an Area Admin do?

data.name: Help_Roles_AreaAdmin_A
data.value: Area Admins manage an entire area (group of molecules). They have broad administrative access across multiple molecules and can configure organization-level settings.

data.name: Help_Roles_Owner_A
data.value: Owners have full system access. They can manage all users, configure role templates and grants, access the Owner Hub with system-wide settings, manage all companies and molecules, and view comprehensive audit logs.

data.name: Help_Roles_Grants_A
data.value: Grants are fine-grained permissions that control exactly what actions a user can perform. Each role template bundles a set of grants. For example, the "ApproveVacations" grant allows approving vacation requests. Administrators can customize which grants each role includes.

data.name: Help_Calendar_Subtitle
data.value: How to use the shift calendar, chores, on-call, and overview pages

data.name: Help_Cal_Shifts_Q
data.value: How does the Shifts calendar work?

data.name: Help_Cal_Shifts_A
data.value: The Shifts calendar shows all shift assignments for your molecule and job type. Navigate between months using the arrows. Click on a cell to see assignment details. Managers can click empty cells to assign shifts or click assigned cells to modify them.

data.name: Help_Cal_Chores_A
data.value: Chores are recurring or one-time tasks assigned to users on specific dates. The Chores calendar shows all chore assignments for your molecule. Managers can create chore types in Admin and assign them to users through the calendar.

data.name: Help_Cal_OnCall_Q
data.value: How does the On-Call calendar work?

data.name: Help_Cal_OnCall_A
data.value: The On-Call calendar tracks duty assignments (Hakam, Lead, etc.) across your area. It shows who is on duty for each date and duty type. Managers with the ManageOnDuty grant can assign and modify on-call rotations.

data.name: Help_Cal_Overview_A
data.value: The Overview page provides a consolidated view of all users in your company with their shifts, chores, and on-call assignments for the month. It includes text entries (notes) and key metrics. This is ideal for getting a high-level picture of team scheduling.

data.name: Help_Cal_QuickEntry_Q
data.value: How do I quickly assign shifts?

data.name: Help_Cal_QuickEntry_A
data.value: Click on any empty cell in the calendar to open the quick-entry panel. Select the user (or shift type in user-mode) and confirm. You can also use the bottom sheet for more detailed assignment options including trainee assignment.

data.name: Help_Cal_Print_Q
data.value: Can I print or export the calendar?

data.name: Help_Cal_Print_A
data.value: Yes. Use the print button in the calendar toolbar to generate a print-friendly version. Managers can also export user data to CSV from the Admin/Users page.

data.name: Help_Admin_Subtitle
data.value: Managing users, organization, and system settings

data.name: Help_Admin_Users_A
data.value: Go to Admin > Users to manage users. You can add new users, approve join requests, edit user details (role, company, job type), lock/unlock accounts, and deactivate users. Use the filters to narrow down the user list.

data.name: Help_Admin_JoinRequests_A
data.value: When new users sign up, they create a join request. Managers see pending requests at the top of the Admin/Users page. You can approve (assigns the requested role and company) or reject each request. Batch approval is also available for multiple requests.

data.name: Help_Admin_Organization_Q
data.value: How do I configure the organization?

data.name: Help_Admin_Organization_A
data.value: The Admin > Organization section lets you manage: Shift Types (work schedules), Chore Types (recurring tasks), Duty Types (on-call categories), and Roles (role assignments). Each has its own management page accessible from the Organization menu.

data.name: Help_Admin_Audit_Q
data.value: How do I view audit logs?

data.name: Help_Admin_Audit_A
data.value: Go to Admin > Audit Log to view a chronological record of all system actions. You can filter by user, action type, and date range. Audit logs track user management actions, shift assignments, approvals, and configuration changes.
